clips.title: The story
paras: At the Crossroads, Mankrik carries grief and a thirst for vengeance. A quilboar ambush separated him from his wife, Olgra, and he now hunts the bristled beasts across the Barrens.

Mankrik and his wife Olgra traveled through the Barrens when quilboar swarmed them during a skirmish at a small tauren settlement. The fighting tore them apart, and Mankrik saw Olgra vanish beneath tusks and thorn-woven weapons. Fury drove him to fight recklessly until a blow left him unconscious. Along the Gold Road, a passing tauren druid found Mankrik bleeding out and bound his injuries. He survived the ambush, but Olgra was gone.

At the Crossroads, Mankrik recovers, paralyzed by grief and consumed by bloodlust. Thork and other local leaders warn that hatred has clouded his judgment, and they refuse to send official war parties. Mankrik refuses to move on. Uncertain of Olgra's fate, he calls on any willing Horde travelers to search the Barrens for signs of his lost mate and slaughter any quilboar they meet.
